description:
Lineage → Precisely Data360 Govern — sink asset that depends on lineage_graph.

Example:
    ```yaml
    type: dagster_community_components.LineageToData360Component
    attributes:
      asset_name: lineage_to_data360
      upstream_asset_key: lineage_graph
      catalog_url: https://api.data.precisely.com/data360/catalog
      client_id_env: PRECISELY_DIS_CLIENT_ID
      client_secret_env: PRECISELY_DIS_CLIENT_SECRET
    ```

Pair with the registry's ``lineage_graph_extractor`` component as
the upstream — it produces the canonical lineage payload every
``lineage_to_*`` sink consumes.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset emitting the canonical lineage payload (lineage_graph_extractor).

catalog_url.label: Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Data360 Govern Catalog REST base URL.

token_url.label: Token URL
token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (override for non-global Data360 tenants).

client_id_env.label: Client ID Env
client_id_env.description: Env var with the Data360 OAuth2 client_id.

client_secret_env.label: Client Secret Env
client_secret_env.description: Env var with the Data360 OAuth2 client_secret.

only_push_on_change.label: Only Push On Change
only_push_on_change.description: If true, skip the catalog POST when the upstream payload_hash matches the last successfully pushed hash. Stored as asset metadata across runs.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
